tasks.label: Dev: Local quick start
tasks.command: docker-compose up -d && { if lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Dev server is already running at http://localhost:3000'; else npm run dev; fi; true; }

tasks.label: Dev: Local full setup + start
tasks.command: npm install && docker-compose up -d && npx prisma db push && npm run seed:all && { if lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Dev server is already running at http://localhost:3000'; else npm run dev; fi; true; }

tasks.label: Dev: Stop local server and db
tasks.command: if lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill $(lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN) && echo 'Stopped dev server on http://localhost:3000'; else echo 'No dev server found on http://localhost:3000'; fi; docker-compose down
